2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Kansas City’s replacement blind-side protection faces Denver’s healthy rush
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: Kansas City expects Patrick Mahomes back for the opener, but left tackle Josh Simmons is out and the Chiefs may have to protect his blind side with an inexperienced replacement. Denver enters Monday night without a game-status designation, giving its defense a healthier platform to pressure a quarterback returning from last season’s knee injury. Bo Nix also returns for Denver, so both quarterbacks are re-entering meaningful action. The decisive tension is Kansas City’s protection against Denver’s rush, with early-down efficiency determining how often that matchup becomes obvious.
2026_01_DEN_KC.model_rationale: Denver can create leverage by attacking Kansas City’s replacement tackle and keeping Mahomes in defined passing situations; the Chiefs need clean early downs to keep that pressure from taking over.
